text: This massage was amazing! They weren’t too busy and took us right away on a Tuesday afternoon. I got the 60 minute massage with balm. My whole body felt properly stretched and relaxed. The balm was soothing. The staff were very polite and friendly. Afterwards we were provided with light refreshment. Would highly recommend!!

PSA: if you want heavy pressure you must ask for a male therapist.

I explicitly asked for heavy pressure before walking in and was assured by the manager it would be OK and just tell my massage therapist. I asked repeatedly maybe 10 times without much improvement. I was basically just getting light brushing against my body and when we moved to the back she basically just lightly rested her elbow for long periods with no movement. I was going to just get up and go because it was a waste of my time. She had the audacity to tell me she knew what she was doing and it was the thai massage technique. I have been to over 100+ massages in Thailand and 200+ worldwide and her massage ranks in the lowest 5. She then told me she couldn’t apply any more pressure and I should have asked for a man. I have received miles better massages with 5x more pressure from women less than HALF her size. It was a pretty rough time.

The redeeming factor moving from a one star to a three star is because they swapped in a male therapist and the rest of the massage was above average. Still not amazing — too much use of low surface area touch points (thumb) and did not pay attention to directional force causing some skin friction and pain. But I appreciate the adjustment and effort.

I really enjoyed my massage! I pulled my back recently but still wanted a Thai massage, and it was wonderful that both the receptionist and masseuse listened to my request and adjusted the massage accordingly. It was still a firm Thai massage, but they avoided deep twists to accommodate my lower back. The salon is clean and comfortable. Will definitely come back

I’ve had a foot massage here twice and was very satisfied both times. The treatment is incredibly relaxing, helps relieve fatigue after long walks, and reduces swelling. After each session, my legs feel light and comfortable. The pleasant atmosphere and attentive service make the experience even better. I will definitely come back again!

I had a wonderful Thai massage here, the space was clean and relaxing and the staff are fantastic, very attentive and kind and provided me with water and tea on top of a great massage!! The private massage area was very comfortable! Would definitely recommend this place!

I had a back, shoulder, head and foot massage. It was very relaxing and pressure was just right on the tough knots. The spa is very clean and has a relaxing ambiance. The spa therapists paid good attention to comfort as the AC made the room cold - provided loose pajamas and cosy blanket! Herbal tea at the end was a lovely touch!

Staff is really accommodating you get welcome water bottles and tea and biscuits at the end of the massage. Atmosphere is very relaxing and prices are affordable. I got the thai massage with oil would recommend!!

Wonderful massage. You start with changing shoes outside. The front desk man was kind and very helpful. Foot wash and then 69 glorious minutes later we felt like melted butter. we got oil shoulder and back and asked for head massage as part of the 60 minutes and it was amazing. 90 minutes is the right about of time don't skimp out unless you do this multiple times during your trip.
I had the foot + neck and shoulder massage. The entire experience is good! Just that the foot massage is average. The place was nice & clean.
I had a great experience and would totally go again! The staff was extremely nice and welcoming and the massage itself was amazing as well! Also very affordable!
Most authentic Thai massage I had on my travels across Thailand. My therapist Mam was professional and very knowledgeable. The Spa was clean and serene. Thank you and I will be back.

The experience was delightful, since the beginning the took their time to explain us what the massage included and the place is gorgeous, so relaxing.
The massage was simply great! The personal who attended me put real effort on the places that most needed it. At the end they received us with a cup of tea and cookies. Absolutely recommend. ✨👌🏻

The spa was very clean, well organized, and relaxing. I tried the mix spa package — 40 minutes Thai massage and 20 minutes oil massage — and it was really great. I truly enjoyed the experience and highly recommend this place.

Amazing service and very thoughtful. I had a neck, shoulder and feet massage with oil and it was very relaxing. The therapist was very professional and kind. The team here is very polite and discrete. The interior of the spa was also very delicate and warm making it a perfect environment for a massage. Will come back again!

Nice ambient with calming environment. Staff is friendly and feel welcoming here. No pressure and rushing while choosing the package. Masseur is observing while doing the massage. They make sure you are comfortable along the way.
Such a lovely place. Everyone is so kind and staff are very attentive. Enjoyed a very good traditional thai massage! Will definitely come back!

I had a wonderful experience at this massage shop! The atmosphere was calm and welcoming, and the staff were professional and attentive. My therapist had excellent technique—she found all the right pressure points and helped relieve the tension I didn’t even realize I was holding. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommended for anyone needing a reset!
Probably one of the coziest massage spa with affordable price. Definitely, worth the price. Highly recommended!

I had a lovely experience at Relaxing Day Massage. A super relaxing environment with a lovely interior. I enjoyed a 60 minute Thai massage and the masseuse was very good, I felt very relaxed afterwards. Normally I don’t find enough pressure is applied for massages, but this masseuse was excellent! All the staff were very friendly and professional, I would definitely go back.

Staff very friendly and whole place had a nice relaxing atmosphere. Got a 1 hour full body massage with essential oils which was amazing, the staff were very good asking if pressure was okay. Finished off with a tea and cookie, really lovely place would recommend.

Myself and my boyfriend came here and it was amazing, the massage was extremely relaxing and we have walked away feeling in top shape! We had the back, neck, shoulders and head massage and the ladies were extremely nice and good at their job. Feeling very loose and will certainly be getting more massages in the future. The front desk team are also very nice and we were welcomed and felt relaxed throughout. Definitely come here for a massage!

Absolutely delightful and relaxing. The prices are really affordable (350 baht for neck shoulder and foot massage - 1h) for this level of massage. The place is beautiful, they welcome you with a cold bottle of drinking water and a cleansing wipe while they clean your feet. Next up is your massage, done silently by their employees. At the end they give you a nice cup of tea and a biscuit.
It was a really good experience ! Thank you so much

Amazing service. I did the aloe Vera massage. It was very soothing and relaxing on my burnt skin. The overall spa has a calm and relaxing vibe, great to get you in the mood. Highly recommend, I had a wonderful and calming experience.
The female receptionist was really friendly. The place is also great. The masseur I got also accommodated to my requests. Overall, it was a really good experience.
Great massage and very relaxing ambiance. Not too cold and this allowed me to fully relax. Very Recommended!!!

Amazing place, very clean, neat, organized. Super friendly staff and my massuse was an absolute expert/master of his craft. I felt so welcome and looked after. No 1 spot for me for massage in Chiang Mai - beautiful. Thank you sooooooooooo much from the bottom of my heart and soul ♥️ 🙏🏼 …

My husband and I did the Thai massage with the warm herbal compress for 90 mins. This was 1800 Baht. Interior is very clean and zen. Aromatherapy was all around, soft music, and dim lights. The staff was friendly, spoke great English, and most importantly, gave a great Thai massage. You can ask for soft medium or hard pressure and I feel much more loose and relaxed afterwards. They give complimentary water before the massage and warm fruit juice and a cookie after. I definitely recommend this place for a good Thai massage!

Great spot with kind staff and good massages. Many different kind of massages that you then go to a 1 of the 3 different floors to receive.

They provide you with a foot wash, some hand wipes, water, and tea and cookie after.

1 hour message is B350 at lowest, and goes higher depending on what you choose.

Enjoy!

Wonderful massages in a very serene atmosphere. It’s very private and they give you a comfortable outfit for the Thai massage so you’re not naked and cold. The massage therapist was really attentive and I noticed how she adapted to where I had a lot of tension without me even having to say anything.

This place was outstanding! I came for a foot massage. Been getting the $300 ones near nimman, but this place was another level. She was doing moves I've never felt before! Would def come here again, very relaxing atmosphere as well!

The used high quality oil for us for only a cheap price. This is the best option in town as it’s cheap close to the airport and quite so that you can have the best experience ever.

Thanks to all the kind staff !

We visited this massage salon and absolutely loved it! We booked a 60-minute massage with balm, and it was just amazing. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxing, the therapists are professional and really know what they’re doing. After the session, I felt light, refreshed, and completely relaxed. Definitely coming back again and will recommend it to friends!
Five stars experience. Cozy atmosphere and lovely stuffs! Relaxing music with perfumes makes ppl feel comfortable. Will come back again. Clean and fresh 😊 …

Amazing massage! I took a 2 hour course with Thai massage and Aromatherapy, and it was great. The therapist kept asking about pressure and was able to accommodate strong pressure upon request with ease. Very satisfied!

Amazing experience! The studio is calm, clean, and relaxing. My therapist was very skilled and immediately knew how to work on my tense areas. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely satisfied. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a quality massage.
Fantastic experience. Very friendly Service, first class massage. Also it opens at 10am - 1 hour earlier than at least two other massage stores nearby. Love this place.

**Absolutely amazing experience!**

The oil massage was incredibly relaxing and the atmosphere was calm and …

Amazing Thai massages, very professional. The team was so nice with us. Plus : offering tea at the end
Really do recommand this place

I got a 90-minute Thai massage here and it was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had in a long time. It started with a short foot massage, which I wasn’t expecting, and ended with a little tea service that felt really warm and personal. The therapist asked me a couple of times about the pressure and adjusted it right away, so I never felt uncomfortable. The music in the room was really calming too — I actually caught myself dozing off a few times. By the time it ended, I almost wished I booked a longer session. I walked out feeling super relaxed. Definitely recommend it!

If you are in Chiang Mai you MUST come here! I did the 60 minute Thai massage with the balm and wow! I have never been so relaxed in my life. My masseuse massaged and stretched me with just the right amount of pressure. I had surgery on my …

Really good Thai massage! The staff were friendly, professional, and made me feel comfortable the whole time. I left feeling much more relaxed and my back felt a lot better afterwards. Clean place and great experience — would definitely come back
Excellent Thai massage, and foreigners can pay using Alipay and credit cards.
Amazing massage! Super relaxing and they gave us free tea afterwards!!!!
I had a really good massage here, the atmosphere is nice and they take care of you well:)
I am very impressed with the interior of the space and also the masseur gave very good massage .. will strongly recommend everyone to come here : )

I had an amazing experience! The therapist was incredibly skilled, attentive, and really focused on the areas. I left feeling completely relaxed and recharged.
Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality massage in a peaceful environment. I’ll definitely be coming back!
Spacious space full with Zen vibe, it’s really a relaxing day as the name presented. It worths to visit and experience the wonderful massage here.
I had a great massage
Beautiful and super relaxing 1-hour foot massage!! Very friendly staff. Highly recommended!!
Friendly staff, perfect foot massage and above all attention and kindness to the customer even after the service, excellent prices to always return to the excellent masseurs
10/10, so good
The environment was quite nice, the staff were very welcoming, and the masseuses were highly skilled. I felt completely relaxed after the massage.
The service was excellent. They washed my feet before the massage and offered me hot tea afterward.
Nice environment !happy experience ,feel so relaxed after message .recommend you to check it out!

This was the most relaxing massage of my life.

I would love to visit again when I come to Chiang Mai.

I'm so glad I asked for a stronger massage before the treatment.

Very nice and professional!!!🥰
The massage therapist was very friendly and professional, making me feel comfortable throughout the entire session. The environment was clean, well-maintained, and had a pleasant, relaxing fragrance. Overall, the experience offered outstanding value for the price — highly recommended!

I've had many massages in Chiang Mai, and this is the worst experience I've ever had.

I don't know where this rating comes from.

First, this is the only place that doesn't give you a form to draw down the areas you want massaged and the pressure you want beforehand.

How are you supposed to communicate with a foreigner?

Second, the first employee had absolutely no strength; they just lightly touched me. The second employee had more strength, but the first half hour was wasted, and they didn't give me a refund.

Finally, after the massage, I wasn't taken to the tea area. The receptionist was playing on his phone in the foot-washing area and there was no farewell.

Furthermore, their air conditioning was extremely cold. After I turned it off, the staff felt hot and turned on the fan, blowing it directly on me, which caused me to have a headache and be unable to sleep at night. This is simply the worst experience I've ever had.

Avoid this place!
Very good and relaxing spa great massage
Such a relaxing massage place! Did the full body thai massage for 1 hr and the pressure was just nice. Will definitely be back here again!
A 90-minute foot, head, shoulder, and back massage for only 525 baht is an amazing deal! They even serve refreshments after the massage! I'll definitely come back!
The force is just right, recommended!

★☆☆☆☆

This was by far the worst massage experience I have ever had in Thailand.

I paid over 500 THB for a 90-minute massage, and it felt like a complete waste of both my time and money. The therapist applied almost no pressure throughout the entire session. Most of the time, she was simply touching my skin lightly or leaving her hands in the same position without actually massaging any muscles or pressure points.

The most shocking part was that she appeared to fall asleep during the head massage.

I have had many massages in Thailand over the years, and I have never experienced anything this unprofessional. This was the first time in my life that I felt compelled to complain to the reception about a massage therapist.

Unfortunately, the reception staff showed no intention of resolving the issue. There was no apology, no compensation, and no effort to make things right. The only response I received was, “I will tell the owner.”

And then what?

Customers pay for a service, not excuses.

Thailand is famous Thailand is known worldwide for its massage industry, but this place completely ruined that reputation for me. I paid for a professional massage and received almost nothing in return. I am extremely angry and deeply disappointed. I will never come back and cannot recommend this place to anyone.

we came at 10:30am and they were open! wonderful massage and was the best feeling post flight! i would recommend!!
I got a foot massage and it was really good. The pressure was just right, and the coconut oil scent was nice.

The technique was unprofessional, and the masseur was extremely lazy.
